notes: maxConnections must be at least maxConcurrent.
Headers timeout is min(10000, requestDeadlineMs). Socket inactivity cutoff is max(requestDeadlineMs, upstreamDeadlineMs)+5000; it is not the upstream total deadline.

At default limits, simultaneous request/response chunk buffers and concatenation can transiently exceed 2 GiB plus 512 MiB static bytes, runtime and TLS overhead. These are bounded payloads, not a hard RSS cap; provision or reduce limits and load-test.
Bodies are not compressed/decompressed; upstream Accept-Encoding identity. Range is unsupported.
No distributed limit store, load balancer, CDN, HTTP redirect listener, HTTP/2, HTTP/3 or WebSocket.
Operating-system firewall, process-account ACL, cert renewal, memory/cpu enforcement and log rotation are operator responsibilities and unverified.
